body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-30 08:00Z, my own slip). A Codex foreground SSH or exec run gives its operator no completion wake. When such an operator's START asks for a backstop at time T, create a DEDICATED one-shot cron at T right away and echo back "SET for T (job id)". Never answer "the existing backstop covers it" unless that backstop fires at or after T. Incident: Engram Coder 11334's DL560 run test-6c60bff3 ended at 07:18Z, and I had promised a check at 07:28Z without setting it. The next backstop fired at 07:57Z, leaving the Engram DL560 lane idle for about 40 min. Engram::Fable's matching workaround: Codex operators start the next run only after the echo.
